parse_version(current);\n382\t\n383\t    for (l, c) in latest_parts.iter().zip(current_parts.iter()) {\n384\t        if l > c {\n385\t            return true;\n386\t        }\n387\t        if l < c {\n388\t            return false;\n389\t        }\n390\t    }\n391\t\n392\t    latest_parts.len() > current_parts.len()\n393\t}\n394\t\n395\t/// Get the platform-specific suffix for release asset   Ok(suffix)\n409\t}\n410\t\n411\t/// Get the asset name for the current platform.\n412\tfn get_asset_name() -> Result<String> {\n413\t    Ok(format!(\"needle-{}\", get_platform_suffix()?))\n414\t}\n415\t\n416\t/// Transform binaries shipped alongside needle.\n417\tconst TRANSFORM_BINARIES: &[&str] = &[\"needle-transform-claude\", install_dir.join(transform);\n428\t\n429\t        println!(\"Installing {transform}...\");\n430\t\n431\t        let response = match ureq::agent()\n432\t            .get(&url)\n433\t            .set(\"User-Agent\", &format!(\"needle/{CURRENT_VERSION}\"))\n434\t            .call()\n435\t        {\n436\t            Ok(r) if r.status() < 400 => r,\n437\t            Ok(r) => {\n438\t Skipping.\");\n470\t                let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);\n471\t                continue;\n472\t            }\n473\t        }\n474\t\n475\t        if let Err(e) = fs::rename(&temp_path, &dest) {\n476\t            println!(\"  Warning: failed to install {transform}: {e}. Skipping.\");\n477\t            let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);\n478\t            continue;\n479\t        }\n480\t\n481\t        println!(\"  {transform} installed to {}.\", dest.display());\n482\t    }\n483\t}\n484\t\n485\t/// Download and install the latest version of needle.\n486\t///\n487\t/// Returns the path to the new binary.\n488\tpub fn perform_upgrade() -> Result<PathBuf> {\n489\t    let check = check_for_update()?;\n490\t\n491\t    if !check.update_available {\n492\t        println!(\"Already up to date (version {})\", check.current_version);\n493\t        return get_current_binary_path();\n494\t    }\n495\t\n496\t    println!(\n497\t        \"Upgrading from {} to {}...\",\n498\t        check.current_version, check.latest_version\n499\t    );\n500\t\n501\t    let asset_name = get_asset_name()?;\n502\t    let download_url = asset_download_url(&asset_name);\n503\t\n504\t    println!(\"Downloading from {download_url}...\");\n505\t\n506\t .call()\n511\t        .context(\"failed to download new binary\")?;\n512\t\n513\t    if response.status() >= 400 {\n514\t        bail!(\"download failed with status {}\", response.status());\n515\t .context(\"failed to read downloaded content\")?;\n523\t\n524\t    // Write the new binary to :testing channel for canary validation.\n525\t    let home = needle_home();\n526\t    let bin_dir = testing_binary.display()\n550\t    );\n551\t\n552\t    // Run canary validation if canary workspace exists.\n553\t    let canary_workspace = home.join(\"canary\");\n554\t    if canary_workspace.exists() {\n555\t        println!(\"Running canary validation...\");\n556\t\n557\t        use crate::canary::CanaryRunner;\n558\t\n559\t        // Honour `self_modification.canary_timeout` instead of hardcoding 300s.\n560\t        // A canary test dispatches a real agent against a real bead, which\n561\t        // routinely takes longer than five minutes — so the hardcoded budget\n562\t        // failed every test by timeout regardless of the binary's health. On\n563\t        // 2026-08-07 that produced \"0/4 tests passed\" for a build whose workers\n564\t        // were observably fine, and rejected it. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n654\t\n655\t/// Compute the SHA-256 hash of a file, returned as a hex string.\n656\tpub fn file_hash(path: &Path) -> binary.\n666\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n667\tpub enum HotReloadCheck {\n668\t    /// No change detected — current binary matches :stable.\n669\t    NoChange,\n670\t    /// New :stable into.\n683\t        stable_hash: String,\n684\t        /// Path to the new :stable binary.\n685\t        stable_path: PathBuf,\n686\t    },\n687\t    /// Hot-reload is disabled or :stable binary not found.\n688\t    Skipped { reason: String },\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t/// Check whether the `:stable` binary differs from the currently running binary.\n692\t///\n693\t/// This is called between LOGGING and SELECTING in the worker loop.\n694\tpub fn check_hot_reload(needle_home: &Path) -> Result<HotReloadCheck> {\n695\t    let stable_path = needle_home.join(\"bin/needle-stable\");\n696\t\n697\t    if !stable_path.exists() {\n698\t        return Ok(HotReloadCheck::Skipped {\n699\t            reason: \"no :stable binary found\".to_string(),\n700\t        });\n701\t    }\n702\t\n703\t    let the current process.\n743\t/// On failure, it returns an error so the worker can continue on the current binary.\n744\t#[cfg(unix)]\n745\tpub async fn re_exec_stable(\n746\t    stable_path: &Path,\n747\t    worker_name: &str,\n748\t    workspace: Option<&Path>,\n749\t    agent: Option<&str>,\n750\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n751\t) -> Result<()> {\n752\t    let stable_path = a.to_string());\n756\t\n757\t    // Retry with ETXTBSY handling - the :stable binary was just written and may be busy\n758\t    let mut child = spawn_with_etxtbsy_retry_child(\n759\t        || {\n760\t            let stable_path = stable_path.clone();\n761\t            let worker_name = worker_name.clone();\n762\t            let workspace = workspace.clone();\n763\t            let agent =      cmd.arg(\"--identifier\").arg(&worker_name);\n768\t                cmd.arg(\"--count\").arg(\"1\");\n769\t\n770\t                if let Some(ws) = &workspace {\n771\t                    cmd.arg(\"--workspace\").arg(ws);\n772\t                }\n773\t                if let Some(a) = &agent {\n774\t                    cmd.arg(\"--agent\").arg(a);\n775\t                }\n776\t },\n783\t        5,  // max_attempts\n784\t        20, // backoff_ms\n785\t    )\n786\t    .await\n787\t    .context(\"failed to spawn :stable binary after retries\")?;\n788\t\n789\t    // Wait for status\n799\t    ))\n800\t}\n801\t\n802\t#[cfg(not(unix))]\n803\tpub async fn re_exec_stable(\n804\t    _stable_path: &Path,\n805\t    _worker_name: &str,\n806\t    _workspace: Option<&Path>,\n807\t \"Downloaded version {} to {}\",\n        check.latest_version,\n        testing_binary.display()\n    );\n\n    // Run canary validation if canary workspace exists.\n    let canary_workspace =
